text: AI chatbots like ChatGPT write answers from word patterns learned from internet text, not by searching the internet for the answer.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.questionWording: Multiple choice: builds sentences by reusing keywords from your question / searches the internet and summarizes the top results / draws on word patterns learned from internet text (correct) / not sure

truthSource.label: NIST, Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative AI Profile
truthSource.oneLine: Large language models generate text from statistical patterns learned in training; they do not look answers up unless a separate search tool is attached.
